name: Per-project setting agent_approval: how a coordinator agent is judged when it approves
aliases: can a coordinator agent approve work
agent approves another agent of the same person
summary: A per-project setting with two values. by-agent (the default): an agent holding the coordinator grant may approve work delivered by another personal agent of the same person, or under a worker credential of that person issued with a name no other account has held (kittrial-5bb.519). by-person: strict, all agents of a person are one party and none approves the others. Either way an agent never approves its own work (its sub-labels count as itself), its person's bare account id, or a name another account also held; the refusal says which. Only an owner or superuser sets it, by web session (PUT /v1/projects/{id}/agent-approval; Members & settings); a credential never can, so no agent sets the rule that judges it. Who and when are recorded and audited; a damaged value reads as by-person. People follow the installation's approval_by_another_party instead. An approval it let through ends with a fixed sentence. Integration's check row and writers ask the same decision from current state (kittrial-5bb.560), so by-person, damage or an ended grant refuses there too. KNOWN GAP: only the web route applies it (over ssh an agent of the same person is never refused).
